about: The README's tool gallery is generated from this map by scripts/readme-blocks.py (D00 T05 §2). Since the split of 2026-11 every tool is developed in its own repository: `moved` lists them (written by tools/app-split/gallery_rows.py from each tool's spec and brand folder), and `tools` holds only what this repository still builds beside the launcher. Each row of `tools` names its icon and the plan that owns its C++ build; the generator refuses a tool the tree has that this map lacks. A folded tool names what it folds into, from the product decisions in docs/brainstorm/2026-09-16-completion-brainstorm.md (decision 6). Re-pointed at D06 T01 §10's registry once that ships.
